proc_p: Most media walls take four to six weeks to make once the design is approved.
steps: We measure the wall and check your TV size, sockets, aerial point and where the cables need to go.
You see the wall in 3D, with any fire, lighting and storage in place, and a quote that lists every part.
The frame, panels and cabinets are made to your wall in our workshop, with cable routes planned in.
We install the wall and leave it ready for your TV, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send us a photo of the wall and your TV size on WhatsApp, or book a visit. We’ll measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote.
